title: Redact transcripts using a local app — ghost
text: Opens local Shiny app asks input directory, output directory, known interviewer names, known participant names, terms redact. app scans supported transcript files input directory, shows likely names review, writes redacted transcript files. Supported input types .docx, .txt, .vtt.

title: Redact transcripts using a local app — ghost
code: ghost(   input_dir = NULL,   output_dir = NULL,   interviewers = character(),   interviewees = character(),   redact_other = character(),   redact_interviewer = TRUE,   include_common_names = FALSE,   redacted_token = "[REDACTED]",   add_blank_line_between_turns = TRUE,   recursive = FALSE,   suffix = "_redacted",   out_format = NULL,   report_redacted = FALSE,   name_review_min_score = 2,   show_completion_notice = TRUE )

title: Redact transcripts using a local app — ghost
text: input_dir Optional folder containing transcripts. NULL, app asks . output_dir Optional folder write outputs. NULL, app asks , defaulting input_dir left blank. interviewers Optional character vector interviewer names prefill app. interviewees Optional character vector interviewee/participant names prefill app. redact_other Optional terms prefill app's -redaction field. redact_interviewer Default value app option controls whether interviewer names redacted body text. include_common_names Default value app option includes package's default common-name list available. redacted_token Default replacement token shown app. add_blank_line_between_turns Default value app option inserts blank line turns DOCX/TXT outputs. recursive Default value app option include subdirectories. suffix Default suffix shown app output filenames. out_format Default output format shown app. One "vtt", "docx", "txt". NULL, app defaults keeping original formats. report_redacted Default value app option prints redaction summaries R console. name_review_min_score Minimum rule-based score candidate appear review app. show_completion_notice Default value app option opens local completion notice outputs written.
